description: This Java class defines a factory for creating Props objects for the ThingPersistenceActor in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It implements a singleton pattern and provides a method to generate Props instances with specific ThingId and DistributedPub parameters.

classes.name: DefaultThingPersistenceActorPropsFactory
classes.description: A singleton factory class for creating Props instances for ThingPersistenceActor, used within the Eclipse Ditto framework to manage actor creation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of DefaultThingPersistenceActorPropsFactory.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns Props for a given ThingId and DistributedPub instance, with input validation.
